changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientdiagnoses AS SELECT pd.id, pd.patient_id, pd.encounter_id, pd.diagnosis_id, pd.type, pd.suspected, pd.major, pd.created_date, pd.created_by, pd.last_modified_by, pd.last_modified_date FROM public.patient_diagnoses pd;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientdiagnoses TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientdiagnoses FROM report_user;
